answer: Agents can gate valuable transactions behind a bonded, rotating endorsement trellis: an identity must earn trust from several independent agents with overlapping counterparties, then lock stake while vouching. A sybil operator must fund each fake with separate collateral and build its history through slow, real interactions; when linked identities coordinate fraud, graph overlap exposes the cluster and slashing burns their bonds. The cost grows with every fabricated identity, while pigment-coded delta records make endorsements auditable.
